new: P16 Config Vault is complete: snapshot manifests, bounded retention, ACTIVE/SAVED/LAST WORKING, component restore, and shared transaction evidence are operational.
P17 Network Doctor / Route Inspector is complete for the accepted scope, combining causal diagnostics and explain-route foundations with shared safety/transaction contracts.

P18 DNS Policy Router is complete and hardware-accepted on a real ARM64 Keenetic, including persisted policies, PolicyN → SO_MARK, reversible IPv4 ingress takeover, transaction commit/rollback, and an external PREROUTING proof.
fixes: The MIPS/MIPSel bootstrap no longer blocks Core installation when an optional thermal sensor is absent: the capability is reported as unsupported and the install gate is separated from optional module status.
The bootstrap evaluates a separate platform gate and verifies local Core health through /api/health after installation.
Fail-closed behavior remains for real platform blockers and module-specific blocked states.
compatibility: All six Beta packages use the coherent 0.10.0~beta.1 train; the GitHub release/tag uses 0.10.0-beta.1.
Beta is published for aarch64-3.10, mips-3.4, and mipsel-3.4: 6 components × 3 targets = 18 IPKs.
ARM64 remains the production target; MIPS and MIPSel remain experimental. KN-1010 provides separate MIPS physical evidence, while KN-2311 Hero 4G+ confirmed MIPSel Core install/UI/runtime.
technical: The P18 production driver reports ready=true with zero blocking unknowns; public persistent activation remains disabled and IPv6 takeover is outside the accepted P18 scope.
The rolling routerforge-beta channel is published transactionally and creates immutable routerforge-v0.10.0-beta.1 at the exact release SHA.
Release preparation starts from exact Dev c3de3316d75c26a4be04247611c02c38b90a9a04; Stable/main is not promoted by this Beta release.
